name: [G-BOOK-12] A 15-digit card number and an empty CVV are rejected @regression
fullName: Guest · Payment [G-BOOK-12] A 15-digit card number and an empty CVV are rejected @regression
description:
Card validation and declined payment (Guest manual G3, payment rules).

The validation tests stop on the add-card sheet, so nothing is charged.
G-BOOK-17 pays with the decline test card; a declined payment leaves no
confirmed booking, which the test checks through the API.
